title: Granting the Benefit Allowance on a Plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans
content:
The benefit allowance on a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans is granted when coverage comes into force, in the amount the coverage sets for a coverage year. An allowance grant or reinstatement is booked only while the plan stands at active, inspection overdue or exhausted, and never against a plan that has closed. The lifetime allowance is a separate ceiling that no amount of annual reinstatement passes, and once it is reached the plan is recorded as exhausted for good. Where the coverage does not reinstate, the allowance granted at the start is all the plan ever has.

## Standings at which a grant is booked

| Standing of the plan | A grant or reinstatement is booked against it |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| inspection overdue | yes |
| exhausted | yes |
| quoted, suspended, expired, cancelled, transferred | no |

The standing is read from the plan record before the entry is booked.

## Two accounting readings

Coverage that does not grant its allowance afresh has one grant to its name: what was granted when coverage came into force is all the plan ever has, and when that is consumed the plan is recorded as exhausted.

Coverage that does grant afresh still meets the lifetime ceiling: no amount of reinstatement passes it, and when it is reached the plan is recorded as exhausted for good.

## Clause no longer in force

The clause below is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis. It is kept here so that withdrawn law is not applied; the yearly and lifetime allowances each plan sets, and whether it grants afresh, remain as the schedules publish them.

> On the coverage that reinstates annually the allowance is granted afresh on each anniversary of the effective date, and any allowance unused in the year just ended does not carry forward.
